title: "incomplete_journal"
description: "A projection rebuild found an actor journal it cannot replay from the start (empty, pruned, or not a journal page)."
---

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mts from the website's docs. Do not edit: run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

**What happened:** A projection rebuild found an actor journal it cannot replay from the start (empty, pruned, or not a journal page).

**How to fix it:** Rebuild only actors whose journal is on and unpruned (no `journal.keep`), through `actorJournalSource` or `studioJournalSource`.

Thrown as an `ActorKitError` (or a subclass) whose `code` is this one and whose `docs` is this page.

The error's `message` names the specifics (the message, state, binding or value involved). See all [error codes](/errors/).
